_readme: Written by scripts/gen-concept-cars.py; read by the asset gallery.

models.name: toy-bumper
models.note: The classic toy coupe: a square-shouldered shell on a dark tray, a big glass cabin, block fenders, a ducktail, steel bumpers and block lamps.

models.name: toy-comet
models.note: A land-speed streamliner: a long faceted wedge on a dark keel, a glass canopy, a tall tail fin, block pods over big rear wheels and small front wheels out on their own.

models.name: toy-scout
models.note: A stubby rally scout on fat wheels: a tall boxy shell, dark flares, a roof light bar and the spare wheel strapped on its tail.

models.name: toy-brute
models.note: A toy hot rod: a narrow nose on skinny front wheels, a chrome blower through the bonnet, a chopped cab, and huge slicks under block fenders.

models.name: toy-hauler
models.note: A toy pickup: a short cab over a chunky nose, an open bed with a crate in it, a roll bar with lamps behind the cab, big steel bumpers.

models.name: toy-bug
models.note: A toy bug: a faceted dome over a short shell, four block fenders with the headlamps on the front pair, running boards, a dark engine vent.
